{{Top|leg}}
'''Big Maxiboss Gurunda''' was the name given by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to a particular [[Stone/Legends|stone]] statue, one of the numerous remains of the [[Elders (Naboo)/Legends|Elder]] civilization that dotted the landscape of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and art collector [[Swagg]] tried to steal Big Maxiboss Gurunda and other such statues. The thief's plan, however, was thwarted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]], and the statuary effigies were move back into their proper positions at the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]], a sunken [[temple]] located north of the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]].
